steps.body: When a fact does not come, break it into known groups: 7 × 6 = 5 × 6 + 2 × 6.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 6 rows of 7.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 42 squares, but not as 6 rows of 7. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.successFeedback: 6 rows of 7 is 42 — one row more than 35.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 42 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 42 squares. The array should stop at 6 rows of 7.

That adds 5, but one more GROUP means adding 7, the size of each group.
